## Install

### Windows (recommended)
1. Download **[LuLuneAutoClicker-Setup.exe](https://github.com/lulunee19/LuLune-Auto-Clicker/releases/latest/download/LuLuneAutoClicker-Setup.exe)**
2. Run the installer (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway)
3. Open **LuLune AutoClicker** from the desktop or Start menu

Portable ZIP: [LuLuneAutoClicker-Windows.zip](https://github.com/lulunee19/LuLune-Auto-Clicker/releases/latest/download/LuLuneAutoClicker-Windows.zip)

### macOS
- Apple Silicon: [LuLuneAutoClicker-macOS-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/lulunee19/LuLune-Auto-Clicker/releases/latest/download/LuLuneAutoClicker-macOS-arm64.dmg)
- Intel: [LuLuneAutoClicker-macOS-x64.dmg](https://github.com/lulunee19/LuLune-Auto-Clicker/releases/latest/download/LuLuneAutoClicker-macOS-x64.dmg)
- First launch: right-click → Open. Allow **Accessibility**.

### Linux
- [LuLuneAutoClicker-Linux.AppImage](https://github.com/lulunee19/LuLune-Auto-Clicker/releases/latest/download/LuLuneAutoClicker-Linux.AppImage) — `chmod +x` then run (X11 / `libfuse2`)
- ZIP: [LuLuneAutoClicker-Linux.zip](https://github.com/lulunee19/LuLune-Auto-Clicker/releases/latest/download/LuLuneAutoClicker-Linux.zip)
